# Study International

> > Your comprehensive guide to international education, covering student visas, university policies, and study abroad opportunities across Australia, Canada, UK, US, and Asia.

Study International provides news, guides, and resources for international students navigating higher education worldwide. The platform covers critical topics from COVID-19 campus policies and vaccination requirements to visa processes, cultural adaptation, and university program spotlights across major study destinations.

## Key Topics

- International students
- Study abroad programs
- Student visa requirements
- Australia education policy
- COVID-19 campus response
- Canadian study permits
- UK Tier 4 visas
- University vaccination policies
- Border reopening for students
- Online and hybrid learning
- Cultural adaptation guides
- Scholarship opportunities
- Australian universities
- Student health and insurance
- International education news

## Student Visa & Immigration

- [Canada study permit process fast-tracked for 7 countries](https://studyinternational.com/news/canada-study-permit-sds-7-countries): IRCC expands Student Direct Stream to Brazil and Americas countries
- [Australian borders for international students: Breakdown by states](https://studyinternational.com/news/australian-borders-students): NSW, Victoria, ACT border reopening plans for international students
- [UK work and study: What international students should know](https://studyinternational.com/news/work-and-study-uk-2021): Tier 4 visa work restrictions and NHS Trust employment rules for students
- [Victoria pilot plan to use hotel quarantine for now](https://studyinternational.com/news/victoria-pilot-plan-student): Victoria's hotel quarantine pilot for international students vs NSW plan
